sections.name: Hero
sections.style: dark background with full-width image overlay

sequences.description: Full-width background image with overlay, large centered heading ('Independence is a choice.'), descriptive paragraph, and two call-to-action buttons ('Explore Our Services' and 'Meet Our Team')
Credentials/awards bar beneath the hero image - a horizontal row of recognition badges/labels: 'Best Place to Work', 'Top 50 U.S. Firm', '2026 Regional Leader', '2026 Best of Accounting Award'

Grid of 3 cards, each with a label/tag overlaying the top, a large background image, and hover-revealed content (description paragraph and CTA link). Cards link to: CEO announcement, Synack partnership, AI assessment.

Section heading 'Featured Industries' followed by an accordion on the left with 6 expandable industry items (Banking, Manufacturing & Distribution, Healthcare, Real Estate, Private Equity/Hedge Funds, Private Clients) each containing a description paragraph and CTA button. On the right (desktop), a large image panel that changes based on selected accordion item.

Content card overlay with heading 'Our Independence in Action' and description paragraph, positioned over a full-width background image (Fort Lauderdale beach) with a centered play button for video playback

Two-column layout with image on the right (man and woman discussing on laptop) and content on the left: eyebrow text 'Our Services', heading 'Comprehensive Solutions, Tailored for You', descriptive paragraph, and CTA button 'View All Services'

Two-column layout with image on the left (office exterior with Kaufman Rossin sign) and content on the right: eyebrow text 'About KAUFMAN ROSSIN', heading 'A Legacy of Independence', descriptive paragraph, and two CTA buttons ('Our History' and 'Meet the Team')

Large centered quote text: 'Independence allows us to stay accountable to our clients and our people, not outside investors.' with attribution: 'Marc Feigelson, CEO-Elect of Kaufman Rossin', quote icon above

Heading 'Get to Know Your Firm Family' followed by a grid of 2 cards, each with a label/tag, large background image, and hover-revealed description + CTA. Cards link to: Wealth Solutions (kaufmanrossinwealth.com) and Fund Administration (kaufmanrossinais.com)

sections.name: Locations
sections.style: light/white background with top divider line

sequences.description: Heading 'Locations' followed by a grid of 5 location items, each with a circular/rounded image and location name: Boca Raton, Fort Lauderdale, Miami, New York, Palm Beach Gardens. Each item links to its contact page.
Centered heading 'Your next breakthrough starts here', descriptive paragraph, and a single CTA button 'Contact Us'
